description: This source file defines the internal class GrainVersionManifest, which manages querying version information for grain interfaces and types within an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for retrieving local versions, available versions, and supported silos for grains and interfaces, based on cluster and grain manifest data.

classes.name: GrainVersionManifest
classes.description: Manages grain interface and type versioning within an Orleans cluster, providing methods to query supported versions and silos supporting particular grain interfaces and types.

methods.name: GetLocalVersion
methods.description: Returns the local version of a specified grain interface type.

methods.name: GetAvailableVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all known available versions for a given grain interface type.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the set of silos supporting a specific grain interface type and version.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns available silos supporting a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns silos supporting a specific grain type, interface type, and version set.
